data.research_question: What defensible current organizational location can be attached to Anduril at street precision without overclaiming headquarters semantics, and what materially new current news advances the selected Anduril target?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical digs roots on current main. Excluded free-range as the meta-root and the previous three successful hourly roots wef-columbus, hunter-biden, and gop, leaving 23 eligible roots: canada-policy-influence, cia, cloarida, dark-academia, devil-corp, dnc, drunk-drivers, fed, flock, graphika, greater-israel, larry-fink, lexisnexis-risk-state-surveillance, occrp-aleph, offshore-leaks, palantir, tech-bro, trump-netanyahu, trump-thiel-circle, us-israel-military-integration, usaid-doge-mortality-accountability, violent-offenders, wef. Dataset seed 16030902380944169605 from SHA-256(main=2d09b53b531008b94dc0f51784fede6d42b37e57|2026-08-18T14:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1) was used to produce a seeded permutation over the 23 roots, preserving approximately uniform dataset-stage priority. The permutation began drunk-drivers, cia, trump-netanyahu, graphika, greater-israel, violent-offenders, dnc, trump-thiel-circle, larry-fink, flock. drunk-drivers was skipped because its only current packet is legacy starintel-documents.jsonl.gz.b64 and the connector reconstruction could not apply Free-Range status/blocker/deduplication semantics to that unreadable compressed transport; Free-Range skips unreadable compressed packets by default. CIA was therefore the first root with a connector-verifiable actionable queue. Its canonical plain Anduril packet contained one queued investigation-target, starintel:investigation-target:anduril-exact-hq-street-and-thunder-flight. Target seed 3934082668212820064 selected that sole target. HQ/location work first reviewed current first-party Anduril sources: the SDK license explicitly states 1400 Anduril, Costa Mesa, CA 92626 as principal place of business, while the January 2026 California expansion release says headquarters remain in Costa Mesa. The pass therefore adds a principal-place-of-business relation to the existing public address without asserting an explicit headquarters street. After that location slice, current news was searched; the material August update is reported advanced Sparrows Point/Tradepoint Atlantic drone-boat facility talks. Because the reported MOU and lease were not recovered as primary records and reporting states no lease was signed, the update is stored as an attributed claim and a recursive primary-record target rather than a completed facility event.
classification_rules: dataset-first seeded permutation after recent-run exclusions
skip unreadable legacy compressed packets rather than invent actionable state
principal place of business is not automatically an explicit headquarters-street designation
headquarters locality plus principal-business street is not silently collapsed into a street-HQ fact
reported MOU or advanced talks are not a signed lease, finalized investment, constructed facility, or operational site
secondary reporting remains attributed until the underlying primary record is recovered
no coordinates are generated without a defensible source or geocoder result

findings.finding: Anduril's first-party SDK license explicitly identifies 1400 Anduril, Costa Mesa, California 92626 as its principal place of business.
Anduril's January 2026 first-party expansion release says its headquarters will remain in Costa Mesa, but does not itself label 1400 Anduril as the headquarters street address.
The Wall Street Journal reported advanced Sparrows Point drone-boat facility discussions and an MOU, while also reporting that no lease had been signed and talks could fail.
Thunder first-flight/procurement milestones and an explicit first-party headquarters-street designation remain unresolved.
